hypotheses.claim: Implementing a true Simulated Annealing (SA) acceptance criterion will improve reliability_score and value_score.
hypotheses.mechanism: SA's probabilistic acceptance of worse solutions, especially at higher temperatures, enables the algorithm to escape local minima more effectively than a purely greedy search or simple random jumps. As temperature cools, the search becomes more exploitative, converging on a minimum.

hypotheses.claim: A balanced hybrid approach combining global random jumps and local Gaussian perturbations with a decaying step size will optimize distance_score and combined_score.
hypotheses.mechanism: Global jumps provide broad exploration to find basins of attraction, while local perturbations refine the search within those basins. The decaying step size (controlled by temperature) ensures convergence to a precise minimum.
